management_response.corrective_action_plan: Several departments have implemented Docusign for the full contract routing process (about 65% of city contracts). text: To increase efficiency and accountability in the contract process, we recommend that City management work with the Finance Department to adopt a comprehensive and integrated electronic contract management system, as funds are available.
